# Draft:Queensball

Queensball is a racket sport popular in Madison, Wisconsin, USA. It was created in 2025 by a 10 year old student in Middleton, Wisconsin, USA as a game to play with his friends, It has since gained popularity in and around the Madison area.
The game is played on a wooden or asphalt court with no net in either singles or doubles. Each player holds a plastic or wooden paddle about the size of a tennis racket with holes to reduce drag. The court is split into three sections: a neutral zone and two "home" zones on either side, each play starts with a player serving from their or their double's respected home zone. After hitting the ball it must bounce in the neutral zone or it will be a point for the opposing player or double, after so it can go into the opposing home zone if it goes out or stops bouncing before getting to the other home zone it is considered a fault and you get the serve. You score if the other player or double is unable to return a good ball. Eight points wins a set, two sets wins a match.
